facts.fact: The OGP IRM review of commitment CI0024 (2018-2020 plan) says the commitment does not introduce legal requirements, civil society reported a lack of consistent regulation on open data, and the IRM recommends developing an Open Data Act; the page has no date so its published year 2020 is used.
